purpose.zh: 扶着椅子单腿前倾，练臀部和大腿后侧
purpose.en: Lean forward on one leg with chair support to work your glutes and the backs of your thighs.

text.zh: 支撑腿膝盖微弯，背挺平身体前倾
text.en: Soften the standing knee and lean forward with a flat back

text.zh: 一只手扶稳椅背，抬起的腿跟着身体往后抬。
text.en: Hold the chair back with one hand and let the lifted leg rise behind you.

text.zh: 小幅度前倾，再慢慢站直。
text.en: Lean only a little, then slowly stand back up.

commonErrors.en: Letting the hip of the lifted leg turn out.

cautions.zh: 用不带轮子的稳固椅子，站不稳就停
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels, and stop if you feel unsteady.

cautions.zh: 腰或大腿后侧疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your back or the back of your thigh hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 改名：「髋铰链」是术语 → 扶椅单腿前倾 / Chair-Supported Single-Leg Deadlift
